items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1车队在Xerox支持下，于周二到访斯托克曼德维尔医院，与年轻患者和NHS工作人员共度时光，把F1的世界带给他们。这是车队全国医院巡访的最后一站。

media.altZh: 阿斯顿马丁F1结束全国医院巡访，到访斯托克曼德维尔医院

items.originalTitle: The final stop on our nationwide hospital tour. On Tuesday, with the support of @Xerox, we visited Stoke Mandeville Hospital, where we spent time with...
items.summaryEn:
The final stop on our nationwide hospital tour.
On Tuesday, with the support of @Xerox, we visited Stoke Mandeville Hospital, where we spent time with young patients and NHS staff, bringing the world of F1 a little closer to them.
detailZh:
我们全国医院巡访的最后一站。
周二，在@Xerox的支持下，我们到访了斯托克曼德维尔医院，与年轻患者和NHS工作人员共度时光，把F1的世界带得离他们更近一些。
detailEn:
The final stop on our nationwide hospital tour.
On Tuesday, with the support of @Xerox, we visited Stoke Mandeville Hospital, where we spent time with young patients and NHS staff, bringing the world of F1 a little closer to them.
